correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Poisson cumulants and exact Beta(1,2)-weighted squared-size-bias transform. Coefficients A_n=2(a)_n/((n+2)!(b)_n) satisfy an explicit ratio, whose sign compared with A_1 gives a global coefficientwise sub-gamma majorant exactly below the proposed threshold. Above it, the first local derivative of the optimization functional is positive, forcing a strict interior global maximum. At the threshold the second local coefficient is strictly negative, giving unique near-critical maximizer and quadratic onset through the implicit-function theorem plus compact global separation. Exact rational checks reproduce 2,746 representative algebraic and numerical assertions; the proof establishes the infinite real-parameter claims.

value.rationale: The complete two-shape Beta-jump phase diagram is a motivated natural classification of sharp variance-normalized concentration poles for a standard bounded compound Poisson model. It locates an explicit smooth boundary between third-cumulant optimality and a genuine interior MGF obstruction and calculates a nonzero quadratic critical rate, extending prior general variational methods beyond isolated Gamma and atomic examples. The uniform-jump constant L/4 is a concrete strict improvement over the customary L/3 range scale. The result does not rely on tiny numerical improvements or unmotivated parameter slices.
